pages.text: :root{--color-primary:#4da6ff;--color-primary-bg:rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.15)}@keyframes splashFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}@keyframes splashHint{0%,100%{opacity:.85}50%{opacity:.4}}body.splash-body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden}.splash-page{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4da6ff 0,#87ceeb 50%,#e0f4ff 100%);z-index:9999}.splash-page-inner{text-align:center;color:#fff;animation:splashFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;padding:0 20px}.splash-page-title{font-size:3.2rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;margin:0 0 .8rem;text-shadow:0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.splash-page-sub{font-size:1.4rem;opacity:.95;margin:0 0 3rem;letter-spacing:.4em}.splash-page-btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 48px;font-size:1.15rem;color:#4da6ff;background:#fff;border-radius:50px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease}.splash-page-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}.splash-page-hint{margin-top:2rem;font-size:.9rem;opacity:.85;animation:splashHint 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}@media (max-width:768px){.splash-page-title{font-size:2.2rem}.splash-page-sub{font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.2em}.splash-page-btn{padding:12px 36px;font-size:1rem}}body.gallery-body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#f5f7fa;min-height:100vh}.gallery-full{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 20px 60px;min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa}.gallery-full-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)}.gallery-full-back{color:#4da6ff;text-decoration:none;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500;transition:opacity .2s}.gallery-full-back:hover{opacity:.7}.gallery-full-title{margin:0;font-size:1.5rem;color:#222;letter-spacing:.1em}.gallery-full-count{font-size:.85rem;color:#888}.gallery-full-masonry{column-count:3;column-gap:14px}.gallery-full-item{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;background:#fff}.gallery-full-item:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}.gallery-full-item img{width:100%;display:block}@media (max-width:900px){.gallery-full-masonry{column-count:2}}@media (max-width:600px){.gallery-full-masonry{column-count:1}}

posts.title: dsh-VoiceChat
posts.text: 一个关于DeepSeek Harness语音生成的项目 项目原址 起因是用dsh时想试试把deepseek变成桌宠 （旮旯给木） 然后想从最简单的语音聊天开始，发现社区没有满意的模型，就自己搓了一个简陋的，接了本地的语音模型 后面是让ai适配更多的api，然后随手发一下gh 并不打算主动维护 有空再接个STT吧
